application_init.desc: The Application singleton resolves data paths, initializes DatabaseManager, and wires Repository, AuthService, and TripPlanner based on module availability.

database_lifecycle.desc: DatabaseManager handles SQLite connections, PRAGMA setup, schema checks, recovery, rebuild flow, and aggregated errors or warnings.

csv_import.desc: The CSV import pipeline normalizes headers, parses fields, and uses transactions plus upsert to load stadium and distance data reliably.

stadium_repository.desc: StadiumRepository encapsulates stadium list queries, sorting, league filtering, single-item lookup, and administrator maintenance interfaces.

distance_repository.desc: DistanceRepository normalizes undirected stadium-distance edges and provides query, adjacency lookup, and update interfaces.

auth_service.desc: AuthService reads key.dat, checks magic and version, and validates administrator input locally with an XOR key.

trip_model.desc: Trip stores route results, the current stop index, and the shopping cart so route browsing and purchasing can share one state model.
